# Nuvio Pro 0.4.14-b1

**AltStore/SideStore source:**
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/albertovinaroz/NuvioPro/pro/store-pro.json
```

## Changelog

### Upstream (NuvioMedia, via luqmanfadlli's fork)
- fix(ios): implement audio language preferences bridge @luqmanfadlli
- fix(player): original audio language preference @tapframe
- fix(player): allow minimum device brightness @tapframe
- use Android User-Agent so IPTV DASH streams do not 403 (#1863) @halibiram
- feat: updated Spanish string resource file for application localization (#1861) @IberianSoldierPC
- fix(player): align mobile control icons with tv @tapframe
- i18n(el): translate delayed addon content state strings (#1851) @nosvasedis
- fix(streams): honor autoplay source loading scope @tapframe
- Updated BG translation and fixes with later versiond (#1838) @viiktr
- fix(player): persist next episode dismissal @tapframe
- Use Simkl for anime ID resolution in skip-intro (replaces ARM) (#1836) @skoruppa
- fix(details): map addon specials season posters @tapframe
- fix(details): optimize large vertical episode lists (#1835) @ThePunpun
- fix(updater): apply theme gradient to download progress @tapframe
- fix(player): keep subtitle picker stable for duplicate tracks (#1800) @halibiram

> **Note for iOS users:** Since Nuvio embeds heavy media frameworks, sideloading tools like AltStore, SideStore, or Sideloadly have to manually re-sign thousands of internal components with your Apple ID certificate. If the installation progress bar looks stuck, don't close it — give it a few minutes to finish signing in the background.

# Nuvio Pro 0.4.13-b7

**AltStore/SideStore source:**
```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/albertovinaroz/NuvioPro/pro/store-pro.json
```

## Changelog

### Pro
- feat(app): change bundle/application ID to com.nuvio.pro, so it can install side by side with the official app instead of conflicting with it @albertovinaroz
- chore: rename the GitHub repo and branch to match (`NuvioMobile-iOS` → `NuvioPro`, `enhanced` → `pro`) @albertovinaroz
- fix(details): fix Skip Intro/Recap/Outro not detecting anything for non-anime shows, fixes #3 @albertovinaroz 
- feat(settings): show each contributor's total contribution count @luqmanfadlli
- fix(trailer): resolve the hero trailer while its start delay is still running, so it starts sooner @luqmanfadlli
- fix(profile): hide the custom background option for non-supporters @luqmanfadlli

> **Updating from an older install?** This release changes the app's identity: the AltStore/SideStore source URL, the repo, and the app's bundle ID all changed. You'll need to re-add the source above (the old one will 404), and install fresh rather than update in place — expect to reconfigure a few local settings, since some data are tied to the app identifier and won't carry over automatically.

> **Note for iOS users:** Since Nuvio embeds heavy media frameworks, sideloading tools like AltStore, SideStore, or Sideloadly have to manually re-sign thousands of internal components with your Apple ID certificate. If the installation progress bar looks stuck, don't close it — give it a few minutes to finish signing in the background.
